h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bareilly

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bareilly

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bareilly

c: FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bareilly to resident welfare associations, colony parks, schools, colleges, cantonment areas and housing societies. We manufacture our Fun Fitness machines at our factory in Vasai, about 1,200 km away, and bring them to Bareilly by road. Our installation team or a dealer in north India fixes them on site.

Many of Bareilly's residential colonies have a small central park looked after by the RWA, and an open gym is now one of the most common requests from residents. The usual question is how to fit it in without losing the lawn. The answer is usually a row of machines along one edge, near the walking path, with clear space marked in front of each. Bareilly has hot summers and cold, foggy winters on the Rohilkhand plains. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts handle both, and a little shade helps in May and June.

richText.heading: Fitting machines into an RWA park

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 1,200 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Can an RWA in Bareilly buy outdoor gym equipment directly from you?
items.a: Yes. Send us the park size and photos. We suggest machines, send a layout drawing and quote, and install after manufacturing at our Vasai factory.

items.q: How do we avoid losing the lawn?
items.a: Place the machines in a row along one edge, close to the walking path. We mark each station and its clear space on the layout so you can see how much lawn remains.

items.q: Do the machines need any electricity or adjustment?
items.a: No. Every Fun Fitness machine works on the user's own body weight. There are no motors, weights or settings to change, which keeps upkeep simple for an RWA.
